user.title: Connect Grok
user.description: Use the HTTPS address of Nabu Casa remote access. This connector has independent permissions and credentials.

entities.title: Selected entities
entities.description: Choose any entities Grok may read. Add named actions in Configure → Actions. Changed entities or actions revoke existing access and require pairing again.

error.invalid_url: Enter only an HTTPS origin ending in .ui.nabu.casa, without a path or query.
error.invalid_action: Enter a name, an optional description and a valid nonempty Home Assistant action sequence.

actions.title: Actions
actions.description: Edit or remove an action using the icons. Changes apply after submitting this list and require pairing again.

pair.title: Pairing code
pair.description:
MCP URL for your custom Grok connector:

{mcp_url}

One-time pairing code:

**{pairing_secret}**

Valid for 10 minutes. Enter it in the authorization window opened by Grok. Creating another code invalidates the previous unused code.

revoke.title: Revoke Grok access
revoke.description: Confirm to invalidate all access tokens, refresh tokens and pending pairing for this connector. A new connection needs a new pairing code.
